mentions.name: Business website rebuild
mentions.description: A business website being rebuilt from scratch using Claude and migrated off WordPress, after the previous web designer broke it and stopped responding. The author reports it going well and expects it to be much better than the old site.
mentions.problem: The business's web designer broke something on the WordPress site and stopped answering, so the owner is rebuilding it themselves.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding my business’ website with Claude. It’s gonna be 10x better and migrate off Wordpress. My web designer broke something and stopped answering so giving it a shot and it’s going great so far.
